body:
This makes the community website ready to host the InstantSearch.js 3 documentation:

- Move "/dev-novel" to "/stories" (like [Vue InstantSearch](https://v2--vue-instantsearch.netlify.com/stories))
- Move "/v2" links to root
- Change from "v1" link to "v2"
- Remove Docsearch searchbox (because it redirects to v2)
- Rename "dev" folder to "storybook" to gradually migrate to Storybook

## Previews

- Website: https://deploy-preview-3265--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/
- Stories: https://deploy-preview-3265--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories

comments.body:
Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit b330658c6a357c20e290a83d013d62029fb449eb

https://deploy-preview-3265--instantsearchjs.netlify.com

@algolia/instantsearch-for-websites The best way to review this is to go to the [deployed website](https://deploy-preview-3265--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/) and to make sure that everything still works.

From my manual tests, everything works as expected.
did you actually disable the `docsearch` call though?

The library `algolia-frontend-components` requires a Docsearch configuration (`new alg.communityHeader(docSearch)`) otherwise it throws.

It should not be possible to interact with Docsearch though (and that's a temporary website).

I checked on the Vue InstantSearch v2 website and it seems like it's not disabled either.

title: chore(website): prepare for v3
